title: Custom Packaging RFQ Checklist for B2B Buyers
description: A practical RFQ checklist for B2B buyers preparing custom packaging quote requests.
purpose: This SourcePack helps B2B buyers prepare a clearer custom packaging RFQ before asking suppliers for structure review, sample discussion or quotation.
questions: What information should buyers send for a custom packaging quote?
What details are needed for custom packaging boxes?
How can buyers compare packaging suppliers without over-specifying the box?

checklist.why: Structure, material and insert choices depend on actual product fit.
checklist.review: MUGE reviews product size, weight, fragility and fit before structure suggestions.

checklist.why: Retail, ecommerce, gift and sample packaging need different priorities.
checklist.review: MUGE maps projects to paper boxes, rigid boxes, paper tubes, PVC/PET boxes, corrugated boxes or pouches.

checklist.why: A reference avoids unclear requests and reduces sampling confusion.
checklist.review: MUGE reviews buyer references while keeping structure, material and finish open for project review.

checklist.why: Logo printing, foil, embossing, lamination and surface paper affect sampling discussion.
checklist.review: MUGE checks artwork status, print coverage and surface finish direction.

checklist.why: Insert, carton packing and shipping protection affect cost and structure.
checklist.review: MUGE reviews insert requirement, product protection and packing method.

rfq: Product photos or reference packaging photos
Target sales channel: retail, ecommerce, gift set, subscription, Amazon, DTC or distributor
Quantity direction, not fixed MOQ claim
Destination market and document requests for case-by-case review
boundary: This SourcePack is a buyer education and sourcing-preparation note. It does not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, certification coverage, food-contact suitability, regulatory compliance, customer cases, ranking, traffic, inquiry volume or third-party endorsement.
